0022600001.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Pistons host the Celtics. Boston has six players listed as day-to-day with rest as the reason and game-time decisions: Derrick White, Mike Conley, Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta, Payton Pritchard and Sam Hauser. Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 104-103 victory over Boston in Detroit on January 19, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pistons a 50% chance of winning.
